objective: Cheaply falsify whether a macro regime absent from prior price-only XAU families has enough gross weekly edge to justify implementation or SQ work.
causal_premise: Falling US real yields and a weakening broad dollar reduce the opportunity and currency cost of gold; simultaneous rises imply the opposite regime.

data.gold: LBMA PM USD price; temporary raw download, aggregate evidence only

frozen_rule.frequency: weekly Friday using last observation known within the week
frozen_rule.long: 13-week change in DFII10 < 0 and 13-week return in DTWEXBGS < 0
frozen_rule.short: 13-week change in DFII10 > 0 and 13-week return in DTWEXBGS > 0
frozen_rule.publication_lag: macro observations from week t may only affect an entry at the close of week t+1
frozen_rule.execution_proxy: gold return from week t+1 close to t+2 close; deliberately later than the known H.10 publication buffer

decision_order: Reject permanently if train gate fails
Open validation only if train passes without changing the rule
Use modern challenge only after validation passes
Never calculate a result on sealed holdout dates in this screen
stop_condition: No threshold, lookback, direction, cost or split tuning after observing results.
